## Import and preview the dataset

```{r}
library(factoextra)
library(cluster)

iris_data <- read.csv("data/iris.csv")
features <- iris_data[, c(
  "SepalLengthCm",
  "SepalWidthCm",
  "PetalLengthCm",
  "PetalWidthCm"
)]

head(features)
```

## Prepare the features

```{r}
features <- na.omit(features)
scaled_features <- scale(features)
```

## Select the number of clusters

```{r}
fviz_nbclust(scaled_features, kmeans, method = "wss")
```

## Perform K-means clustering

```{r}
set.seed(42)
kmeans_model <- kmeans(scaled_features, centers = 3, nstart = 25)
kmeans_model
```

## Visualise the clusters

```{r}
fviz_cluster(kmeans_model, data = scaled_features)
```
